title: Text: DET Doug Teter ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Call me when you get a min... know it’s a work day. No real rush and I’ll make it quick. Writing about Norris and I want to make sure I don’t write anything that can get him in trouble
I heard Sam is leading the COVID thing and he’s been doing a really good job with it
K, just thinking about story ideas. He could use the pub for running a tight ship on something like that
Yeah he’s really organized and driven.  I like him a lot
